feeds.title: Children's Mental Health Ontario Blog
feeds.description: Children's Mental Health Ontario works to identify and develop solutions to important policy issues affecting the child and youth mental health sector. Read our latest CMHO blog posts for expert tips and resources for families with children and youth with mental health concerns.

feeds.title: Mind Your Mind Blog
feeds.description: At Mind Your Mind, young people are valued as experts in their own experience and choose to engage in whichever way makes sense for them. It exists in the space where mental health, wellness, engagement, and technology meet and serve to co-create new mental health resources.

feeds.title: Mind You Reflections on mental illness, mental health and life
feeds.description: Reflections on mental illness, mental health, and life. Authored by Marvin Ross, the MH advocate.

feeds.title: Sanctuary Mental Health Ministries Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Sanctuary Blog, where we open up important conversations about mental health and faith, exploring the discomfort of real life experiences and giving them space to breathe. Sanctuary Mental Health Ministries is a Christian non-profit that equips the Church to support mental health.

feeds.title: Life Voice Blog
feeds.description: This blog is here to help guide you. It contains articles and videos to educate. We look at how to improve mental health. We also look at how to offer good support to those living with a mental illness or thoughts of suicide.

feeds.title: Calltime : Mental Health
feeds.description: How to manage mental health issues in the workplace: articles, best practices, and helpful information for yourself and others. Calltime: Mental Health is a multi-union initiative to educate and assist workers, employers, and families with concerns about mental health and addiction issues in the British Columbia film and television industry.

feeds.title: Anchored Therapy Centre Blog
feeds.description: Enjoy the latest blog posts and news from Anchored Therapy Centre focusing on relationships, anxiety, anger, stress, depression and many more topics. Anchored Therapy Centre offers in-person Psychotherapy and counselling to individuals, families, and couples in Halton Hills and surroundings as well as Virtual therapy across Ontario.

feeds.title: Serenity Counselling Blog
feeds.description: Empowering you to embrace your unique journey is my goal. I meet you where you are, honor your individuality and help you navigate your path forward. Whether you are seeking support for anxiety, depression, career exploration, relationship issues, or simply a desire for personal growth, our sessions will be tailored to your specific needs. Let's create a therapeutic non-judgmental space where authenticity thrives.

feeds.title: Oaks Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: Oaks Mental Health offers training to organizations and individuals across Canada. Our education emphasizes evidenced-based approaches and practical applications. We write about all things mental health related. From anxiety to eating disorders to psychosis, we want to encourage compassion, understanding, and practical support for people who suffer from these conditions.

feeds.title: Journey Counselling Blog
feeds.description: We are a network of Calgary psychologists, marriage counselors, and Calgary therapists who specialize in helping people overcome the hurdles that sometimes make life, relationships, school, and work difficult. We provide individual counseling, couples and marriage counseling, as well as family and group counseling.

feeds.title: Everwell Counselling Blog
feeds.description: We know it can be hard for people who are struggling with their own -or a loved one's - mental health to find the resources they need. Whether you are looking for a safe space to anonymously explore your feelings or research your options, we hope to provide you with the knowledge that you are not alone.

feeds.title: YouthSMART Blog
feeds.description: CMHA Calgary's YouthSMART (Youth Supporting Mental Health and Resiliency Together) integrates collaborative, youth-initiated mental health learning opportunities in local junior and senior high schools. Canadian Mental Health Association - Calgary Region (CMHA Calgary) builds awareness and provides education and support for individuals and families living with a mental health or substance use concern or a loss by suicide.

feeds.title: Never Alone Blog
feeds.description: Never Alone's focus is on sharing personal stories, exercises, and actionable help, to inspire the world to break the stigma around mental health conversations. We are a growing community, inspiring the world to make Mental Health as normal as any other health topic.

feeds.title: Edmonton Counselling Services Blog
feeds.description: Edmonton Counselling Services provides in-person and online therapy for addiction, mental health & relationships. In this blog, you will learn more about common Mental Health issues, their causes, and proactive tips to counter or prevent them. Stay informed and healthy for better living.

feeds.title: UPsilon Clinic Blog
feeds.description: The UPsilon Clinic Blog covers topics related to mental health and advocacy for improved mental health services for Canadians. UPsilon clinic provides virtual psychological services, specializing in addressing the mental health needs of the people.

feeds.title: Mighty M0use for Mental Health
feeds.description: In 2000, as a single working mom of two, I started having delusions for the first time. By 2008, I had lost custody of my daughters (they were living with their Dad full-time), I had lost my job, and I lost my housing all due to mental illness. I spent the next 3 years homeless, including one year of living in my car. Fortunately, in 2011, I received life-changing treatment at The Royal in Ottawa and I was able to get my life back on track. My blog is all about mental health.

feeds.title: Wellin5 Blog
feeds.description: Wellin5 online mental health counselling blog covering all topics related to mental health and how counselling can benefit you. Wellin5 is a team of ambitious forward-thinkers in the field of mental health, working to meaningfully impact the world in a positive way. We developed an online counseling platform to combat mental health challenges that anyone may be experiencing.

feeds.title: Sana Counselling Blog
feeds.description: Our registered counselors focus on supporting people with anxiety, relationship issues, trauma, epilepsy, and more. Our goal is to help you feel as supported as possible in your process. Read our blog for comprehensive insights into the brain and mental wellness also all about how to cope with anxiety, trauma, and relationship issues.

feeds.title: Alberta Black Therapists Network Blog
feeds.description: The Alberta Black Therapists Network (ABTN) is made up of a group of Black licensed and regulated professionals from various interdisciplinary backgrounds working in the field of mental health and addictions. We aim to increase emotional wellness and the application of self-care skills such as self-awareness, self-confidence, positive thinking, goal setting, responsible decision-making, and healthy relationships.

feeds.title: CMHA National Blog
feeds.description: Canadian Mental Health Association (CMHA) is the most established, most extensive community mental health organization in Canada. Through a presence in more than 330 communities across every province and one territory, CMHA provides advocacy, programs and resources that help to prevent mental health problems and illnesses, support recovery and resilience, and enable all Canadians to flourish and thrive.

feeds.title: ReDiscover Psychological Services Blog
feeds.description: Your Weekly Dose of Mental Health Articles. ReDiscover is a nonprofit community mental health center that provides comprehensive programs and services for men, women, and children whose lives have been affected by mental illness and/or substance use disorders.

feeds.title: Community Mental Health Action Plan Blog
feeds.description: The Community Mental Health Action Plan is committed to improving mental health in the Edmonton area. The Action Plan's focus is to improve mental health service delivery, system integration, and the use of evidence-informed practices. Through collaboration, we create mental health resources, evidence-based tools, and training opportunities for the community.

feeds.title: Canadian Red Cross Blog » Mental Health and Well-being
feeds.description: Read blog posts from the Canadian Red Cross about mental health and well-being, including tips and resources. The Canadian Red Cross Society is part of the largest humanitarian network in the world, the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. We help people and communities in Canada and around the world in times of need and support them in strengthening their resilience.

feeds.title: The Dot Canada Blog
feeds.description: It takes courage to examine your life and decided there are things you would like to change. And it takes more courage to do something about it. Our blog features mental health and wellness information and expert advice from registered Ontario mental health professionals to support you in your goals for improved well-being so you can live with purpose and intention toward the life you want.
